name: Innkeeper Allison
summary: At the Gilded Rose, Innkeeper Allison welcomes travelers and merchants in Stormwind's Trade District. The inn stands between the bank and auction house, offering hearthstone bindings, drinks, and shelter.

sections.title: Hospitality in the Trade District
sections.body:
Innkeeper Allison welcomes travelers at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind. Between the Trade District auction house and the city's main vaults, its ground floor draws peddlers, mercenaries, and visiting diplomats. She keeps order behind the counter and offers lodging and hearthstone services.

Allison also joins local holiday festivities. At times, she coordinates small errands for traveling heroes who seek rest in the capital.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Allison?
faq.answer: Find Innkeeper Allison behind the counter on the Gilded Rose's ground floor. The inn is in Stormwind City's Trade District, between the central bank and the auction house.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Allison offer?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Allison lets travelers bind their hearthstones to the Gilded Rose and offers food and drink. She also takes part in seasonal events and holidays.

faq.q: Does Innkeeper Allison offer any quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Innkeeper Allison joins seasonal festivities and can sometimes help travelers with city errands as they seek aid across the realm.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can rest at the Gilded Rose after returning from the front lines and bank your spoils there.
